query: SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname, permissive, roles, cmd, qual, with_check FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('users','dashboard_report_schedules','audit_logs','webhook_deliveries','schema_drift_monitors','schema_drift_runs','tra_z_report_archive_schedules','tra_z_report_archives','tra_gateway_alert_settings','tra_gateway_alert_events','tra_vat_anomaly_settings','tra_vat_anomaly_events','bank_market_rates','dse_market_tickers','market_provider_settings','market_provider_uptime_logs','market_provider_incidents') ORDER BY tablename, policyname LIMIT 100;
